title: Duckfile Security Configuration
description: Security configuration for Duckfile host allow/deny lists. This configuration should be stored outside of duck.yaml to prevent supply-chain attacks where both targets and security policies could be modified together.

allowedHosts.description: List of Git hostnames that are allowed for template repositories. If empty, no restrictions apply.

deniedHosts.description: List of Git hostnames that are explicitly denied. Takes precedence over allowedHosts.

strictMode.description: If true, fail if no host restrictions are configured. Useful for enforcing security policies.
